notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with at least three spore counters on it.
description:
Activate a creature you control by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
The Saprolings enter the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer twice.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put two spore counters on any creature you control.
Resolve the second Tainted Observer trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
